ons.text: Topos is raised by Ixidor, who, exiled to the desert of Otaria, gains Lowallyn's magic and discovers his illusion powers, building the kingdom. Ixidor creates the angel Akroma to avenge Nivea against Phage, and Akroma leads his armies against the Cabal, who with Kamahl's Krosans track her to Topos.

Ixidor's spark makes nightmares real, and Phage's slain souls become deathwurms that tear rents in reality, creating the Nightmare Lands, until a deathwurm born from Nivea's murder devours Ixidor. Akroma then takes control of Topos and Kamahl swears to save his sister.
Jeska resurfaces within Phage after the devastation and absorbs all the nightmares into herself with Akroma and Kamahl's aid.

lgn.text: The joint Cabal-Krosan army flees Phage's deathwurms at Topos, and Akroma takes control of Topos after Ixidor is gone. Stonebrow tries to kill Akroma but is brainwashed to worship Ixidor, and he leads Topos in war on Sanctum when Akroma vanishes after the deathwurm.
Inside the deathwurm, Akroma finds Ixidor, who heals her and shows her the way out, and Akroma and Phage battle until Stonebrow injures them both and Phage flees to give birth.
